thread:
sam_ops: quick proposal — trial a "fast-close" path for low-risk postmortem actions: 3d triage + 14d full remediate, scoreboard if late

lee_sre: sounds reasonable for low/medium severity. how do we classify risk quickly?

morgan_pm: a tiny rubric: if customer-facing outage -> severity high (shorter SLAs), infra-only with rollback -> low. owner selects when creating ticket

sam_ops: plus add a one-line verification checklist in the ticket body — ops-bot will block close if empty

devbot: tip: use `/remediate new --owner=@sam_ops --due=3d --title="cache invalidation cleanup"` to bootstrap ticket from thread

lee_sre: can we auto-tag services with repeat issues? if service hits 3 remediations in 90d, ping eng-sre and product

morgan_pm: comms cadence: status blip in incident thread every 72h. short, e.g. "owner: working, mitigation put, ETA 2d"

sam_ops: also propose weekly async scoreboard in #eng-oncall. ops-bot posts Mon 09:00 with stale items

lee_sre: IC rotation tweak: 1-week shadow then 2-week lead. rotate remediation sync facilitator with IC role

morgan_pm: pilot owners: sam to wire slash command, lee to define recurrence rules, i'll run pilot retro after 4 weeks

ops-bot: scheduled: pilot kickoff note will post Mon 09:00. weekly scoreboard enabled.

sam_ops: i'll open a tracking ticket and drop the link here. low-friction pilot for 4 weeks, metric = % overdue Stage B down by 50%

morgan_pm: nice. if scoreboard shows >3 stale items mid-pilot, we tighten cadence to twice-weekly reviews

lee_sre: agreed. small, measurable, and keeps owners accountable. :thumbsup:
